summary: REGENXBIO Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered public offering of 10,003,889 shares of common stock and 1,111,111 pre-funded warrants at a public offering price of $9.00 per share, with total gross proceeds of approximately $100 million. The underwriters have a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 1,667,250 shares. This is a routine equity financing under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
